name: Ramathaim-zophim

related_people.name: Elkanah
related_people.role: the Ephraimite of this town, husband of Hannah and Peninnah

related_people.name: Hannah
related_people.role: of this town, whose vow at Shiloh brought the birth of Samuel

related_people.name: Peninnah
related_people.role: Elkanah's other wife of this town, who provoked the barren Hannah

description: The home of Elkanah and his wives Hannah and Peninnah in the hill country of Ephraim, where Hannah's prayers for a child were answered with the birth of Samuel, whom she later brought to Shiloh to serve the Lord as she had vowed (1 Samuel 1:1-2:11).
